## D-001

**Historical C1 note contradicts its own sweep**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | RESOLVED |
| Effect | Contradicts a claim or requirement |
| Kind | claim vs artifact — What a claim or note says differs from what its artifact contains. |
| Claims | [C1](claims/C1.md) |

- [evidence/archive/notes-v1/C1_four_bar.md](../evidence/archive/notes-v1/C1_four_bar.md): Baseline is a change-point linkage with a 78.46-101.54 deg transmission angle and confirmed over-center locking.
- [evidence/archive/C1_four_bar_sweep.v1.json](../evidence/archive/C1_four_bar_sweep.v1.json): Baseline row: non-Grashof, 90.0/90.0 deg, envelope 0.0; every one of 81 rows is identical.

**Next action.** None for the record; the design question continues as D-002.

**Resolution.** The note is archived as superseded and the claim no longer repeats its figures. (Record correction in the evidence-discipline change; not an engineering review.)

*Found by:* Reading the committed JSON against the note during the evidence review of 2026-09-28.

## D-002

**The specified four-bar cannot be assembled**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | OPEN |
| Effect | Contradicts a claim or requirement |
| Kind | requirement vs model — A model result does not meet a stated requirement. |
| Claims | [C1](claims/C1.md) |

- [evidence/archive/notes-v1/C1_four_bar.md](../evidence/archive/notes-v1/C1_four_bar.md): Ground 25, coupler 60, input 15, output 15 mm deploys the fin 0-92 deg.
- [docs/EVIDENCE/C1_four_bar_sweep.json](EVIDENCE/C1_four_bar_sweep.json): Over the 0-92 deg drive range the B-D distance never exceeds 29.6 mm (40 mm at any angle), but the coupler and output circles only meet at 45 mm or more; no pose closes. None of the 81 variants closes at any pose.

**Next action.** A human confirms the intended topology and link dimensions; then the model is re-run and reviewed.

*Found by:* Loop-closure check (circle intersection) added in model revision 2.

## D-003

**C1 model revision 1 reported placeholders as results, and its tests passed on them**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | RESOLVED |
| Effect | Contradicts a claim or requirement |
| Kind | implementation defect — Software produced values that do not follow from its inputs. |
| Claims | [C1](claims/C1.md) |

- [evidence/archive/C1_four_bar_sweep.v1.json](../evidence/archive/C1_four_bar_sweep.v1.json): transmission_angle() returned 90.0 for poses that cannot close; an empty trajectory produced an envelope of 0.0; the Freudenstein constants were misassigned.
- [evidence/archive/test_four_bar.v1.py.txt](../evidence/archive/test_four_bar.v1.py.txt): Tests asserted 40-140 deg and a bounded envelope, and passed because the placeholders sat inside those bounds.

**Next action.** None; keep revision 1 archived as a worked example of a vacuous pass.

**Resolution.** Revision 2 returns null for unassemblable poses and solves closure by circle intersection; tests check geometry and null handling. (Model and test correction in the evidence-discipline change; software-tested, not engineering-reviewed.)

*Found by:* Comparing compute_theta4 with direct circle intersection for a linkage that does close.

## D-016

**Architecture diagram omitted the rocket's fins-deployed ignition gate**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | RESOLVED |
| Effect | Informational |
| Kind | documentation vs implementation — Documentation disagrees with firmware or software behavior. |
| Claims | [C2](claims/C2.md) |

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): ARMED --> IGNITING on the IGNITE command.
- [Firmware/Rocket/src/main.cpp](../Firmware/Rocket/src/main.cpp): IGNITE is refused unless is_fins_deployed(); the refusal was printed to USB serial only and never reached the telemetry record.

**Next action.** Bench-verify that the refusal now reaches the dashboard CSV.

**Resolution.** Diagram updated; the rocket now reports CMD_REJECT:ignite_fins_not_deployed and CMD_REJECT:ignite_not_armed over UART, which the launcher already forwards. Compile-verified only. (Documentation and firmware logging change; not bench-verified.)

*Found by:* Reading the IGNITE branch in processSerialCommands().

## D-017

**Ignition requires deployed fins, but deployment requires a boost-level acceleration**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | OPEN |
| Effect | Weakens a claim's support |
| Kind | design logic — Two implemented rules cannot both be satisfied in the intended sequence. |
| Claims | [C2](claims/C2.md) |

- [Firmware/Rocket/src/main.cpp](../Firmware/Rocket/src/main.cpp): Deploy fires only after a >15 g x-axis reading while not IDLE; IGNITE is refused unless the deploy flag is set.
- [Firmware/Launcher/src/main.cpp](../Firmware/Launcher/src/main.cpp): After sending IGNITE the launcher waits 5 s for IGNITED, then aborts.

**Next action.** A human decides the intended ordering. On the bench this ordering acts as an extra interlock; do not remove it without a safety review.

*Found by:* Tracing the nominal command sequence through both firmwares.
